currency: EUR ordinary Sanofi share, not SNY ADR
share_definition: H1 2026 diluted weighted average; not current ending shares

normalization.Base_anchor: 8.089 reported +0.411 assumed operating improvement -0.350 assumed economic SBC -0.350 assumed reserve for cash quality, disposals, litigation and ongoing product replacement =7.800. Not reported FY2026 guidance. Existing small acquisitions/restructuring and lease repayment are already in reported FCF and not deducted twice. Large historic strategic transactions are not treated as annual repeating costs; new incremental pipeline costs are risks in the scenario.

upfront_note: Announced USD1bn Regeneron upfront. EUR1bn is an analyst cash reserve, not a claimed FX conversion or confirmed payment. Deduct at valuation date once; do not also deduct in recurring FCF.
method: Equity cashflow DCF, after interest and lease costs, ten end-year cashflows labelled 2027-2036 from 2026 normalized anchor. Four pre-LOE growth years, six post-LOE years. End-year discount convention is simplified relative to October valuation date. Debt rolls without net new borrowing; no balance cash/debt bridge, no separate Opella stake value, no buyback uplift; fixed diluted shares. Economic SBC cost embedded in anchor, no additional future dilution.
score_points: Rozumiem biznisu
Lieky a vakcíny; vývoj je komplexný, zdroje príjmu sú identifikované.
Kvalita biznisu
Silná produkcia liekov a cashflow, regulačné bariéry.
Moat
Patenty a biologické lieky; výhoda nie je trvalá bez nových produktov.
Finančné zdravie
Dlh vzrástol; dostupná likvidita a cashflow ho zmierňujú.
Cashflow
Silný pokračujúci biznis; normalizácia a R&D náklady zostávajú neisté.
Dividenda
Silný výnos a rozumné pokrytie, bez garancie budúcej výplaty.
Manažment
Transformácia a nové produkty, akvizície vyžadujú disciplínu.
Rast
Dupixent a launch produkty, pipeline oceňujeme scenármi.
Valuácia / MOS
Base rezerva približne19 %, ale cena je nad Bear hodnotou.
Riziká / odolnosť
Koncentrácia Dupixentu, patenty, vývoj liekov a záväzky partnerstvám.
limitations: Maintenance R&D, pipeline success, future licensing/milestone cash needs and exact biosimilar entry uncertain.
Aggregate FCF paths approximate combined Dupixent erosion and product replacement; not a product-level probability-weighted model.
Company FCF is a non-IFRS adjusted measure; some litigation and large transactions excluded, so reserve explicitly estimated.
Borrowing refinancing assumed, material changes in debt or refinancing cost require revision.
Retained Opella stake not assigned separate value; possible upside not monetized as certain cashflow.
